The '''RK-77 cluster missile''' was a type of [[Cluster missile/Legends|cluster missile]] produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Well-known for their quick lock-on [[Time/Legends|time]], RK-77 missiles were favorites for many [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in dogfights; the missiles' small frame sacrificed fuel and payload in exchange for the ability to carry large numbers of the missiles into battle.<ref name="Starfighter" />
